Hi!  
I came across your AI trading system in r/ai\_trading and was really impressed by its architecture and learning approach.  
I’m working on my own trading system with multiple strategies, technical analysis, historical market data and paper trading.  
I’m particularly interested in how your neural networks, forecasting models and feedback-based learning work together.  
Would you be open to exchanging ideas? I’d love to learn more about your approach and discuss possible technical improvements.  
Thanks, and great work on your project!
